notes.title: Update
notes.content:
Fixed the following bugs:
1. At the first level, the character could get stuck under the chain, now the chain is slightly reduced.
2. At the first level, the hero, taking the box, could come up with him in his hands to the wall and let go, the consequence of these actions was that the object remained inside the wall. Now the box will shoot back, that is, the wall will push it. Our team is trying to eliminate the possibility of penetration of objects into the walls, but while we are in the process, so temporarily made "ejection" so that players do not lose items. 
3. Completely redesigned and changed all the clues on the first level.
4. Fixed other small bags
4. We were informed about some problems with localization(translation) into Russian, at the moment we are working on it.
